say:1:1730159601:1.text: You've come to the right person! You know King Rolan appeared and thwarted Orion and Cyran's plan, right?
say:1:1730159601:1.source_cn: 那你就问对人了！还记得之前罗兰大帝在危机时刻现身，挫败...
say:1:1730159601:1.male: You've come to the right person! You know King Rolan appeared and thwarted Orion and Cyran's plan, right?

say:2:1730159602:1.text: I'd say King Rolan stepped in and treated King Maximilian. After all, the empire needs a steady hand on the tiller...
say:2:1730159602:1.source_cn: 这一次陛下奇迹般恢复健康，八成也是大帝的手笔！他不忍心...

say:3:1730159603:1.text: It must've taken too much out of King Rolan, so he can't maintain his human form and has to remain as a little fox!
say:3:1730159603:1.source_cn: 但也因为力量耗费过多，无法维持人形，只能以小狐狸的形态活动！

say:4:1730159604:1.text: On the other hand, many believe that Magister Merlin was the one who treated King Maximilian.
say:4:1730159604:1.source_cn: 当然，也有不少人认为其实是大魔法师梅林治好的陛下。
say:4:1730159604:1.male: On the other hand, many believe that Magister Merlin was the one who treated King Maximilian.
say:4:1730159604:1.female: On the other hand, many believe that Magister Merlin was the one who treated King Maximilian.

say:5:1730159605:1.text: Merlin's said to have discovered a miraculous potion that cures all ailments during his journey across Esperia...
say:5:1730159605:1.source_cn: 据说梅林周游伊索米亚时，曾发现过一种神奇的药水，能够疗...

say:6:1730159606:1.text: So, who gets the credit for the King's recovery?
say:6:1730159606:1.source_cn: 所以，究竟是谁带来奇迹，让陛下成功恢复了健康呢？
